tests.exercises: The 1-D teleseismic synthetics stage (step6_1d_dsm_synthetics.sh) of the PKP-precursor / ULVZ scenario: dsmti integrates the radial equations of a spherically symmetric Earth frequency by frequency (compwave.f, the angular-order loop with its every-500-orders convergence test in param.f check_amp_significance) for an explosion source and writes the complex displacement spectrum of every receiver (savespec.f); spectotime then filters and inverse-transforms them to SAC seismograms. The receivers sit in the PKP precursor (two receivers at 129.998 and 130.000 degrees, source at 600 km, 2401 s window) window. Shipped as 4 byte-identical or whitespace-identical copies: Explosion_demo/OUTPUT_FILES{,_0.5Hz_DSM1D,_0.5Hz_DSM3D} and Explosion_DSM_database_existing_demo/OUTPUT_FILES_0.5Hz_DSM3D.
tests.why: Suitable: a complete DATA deck the repository ships (dsm_model, the four depth and distance tables, Par_file_freq2sac, station_list), runs end to end natively with dsmti under MPI and spectotime. The shipped frequency count (2048 to 16384) is hours on hundreds of ranks; the check runs the deck at the frequency count run.sh's SAB_NFREQ sets (a band limit, the same solve per frequency) and regenerates its reference on the pinned build, because the shipped SAC files are full-band and not a reference for a band-limited run. Pointwise: a deterministic linear forward solve on a fixed frequency grid with no time stepping, no iteration and no random draw.

The receivers sit in the PKP (six Hi network receivers at 62.6 to 66.0 degrees, source at 630 km, 8-zone base model, 4000 s window) window. The scenario ships its 1-D SAC products under OUTPUT_FILES_DSM1D_1.1Hz/1D_DSM but not the DATA deck; the deck is what its own step6 writes from DATA/dsm_model_base, DATA/CMTSOLUTION and DATA/tele_station.txt (WORK/DSM/1D_tele_syn/explosion/DATA), reproduced with a stub sbatch.
tests.why: Suitable once the deck is regenerated with the scenario's own step6: the shipped Par_file_SEM_DSM is internally inconsistent (TIME_LENGTH_DSM_SOURCE_TO_BOX + TIME_LENGTH_DSM_BOX_TO_RECEIVER = 6000 s exceeds TIME_LENGTH_DSM_1D = 4000 s, which step6 rejects), so the deck was generated with stage metadata step6 accepts and the 4000 s window the scenario declares; recorded as a pitfall.

tests.exercises: The 1-D synthetics stage of the PKP-precursor / ULVZ scenario in its moment-tensor mode (SINGLE_FORCE_ENZ=0): step6 runs dsmti six times, once per unit moment-tensor component (Mzz, Mrr, Mtt, Mzr, Mzt, Mrt), converts each to SAC and combines them with the CMTSOLUTION. The off-diagonal components excite the toroidal (SH) system and the m = +-1, +-2 azimuthal orders that no explosion deck reaches (compwave.f comp_excitation, comp_wavefield with whole_matrix_tor). two receivers at 130 degrees, source at 600 km, 2401 s window. MomentTensor_DSM_database_existing_demo is the same scenario with the same DATA (dsm_model_base, CMTSOLUTION, tele_station.txt, Par_file) and is covered by this row.
tests.why: Suitable: the six decks are what step6 writes (reproduced with a stub sbatch and the step-1 model the scenario's explosion sibling ships); the check runs the six elementary sources at SAB_NFREQ frequencies each and grades all six spectra and seismograms. The CMTSOLUTION synthesis script lives outside the module (auxiliary/) and is not graded. Pointwise for the same reason as the explosion decks.

tests.exercises: Step 4 of every scenario, the source-to-box Green's-function database: dsmti for the explosion source with receivers on the SEM box's radial nodes (26 lower-mantle depths in zone 3 and 5 outer-core depths in zone 2 at 3 epicentral distances), saving velocity instead of displacement (save_velo=2), the six strain components (stress/), and the fluid displacement, potential and pressure (disp_fluid/, potential/, pressure/), which the 1-D synthetics never write; 1400 s window.
tests.why: Suitable with the scenario's own knobs: prepare_src_to_box.py sizes the tables from the Par_file (DSM_DISTANCE_SPACING_DEGREES=1.0, DSM_BOX_DISTANCE_SAMPLES=2, DSM_DISTANCE_MARGIN_DEGREES=1.0 shrink the 1143 distances of the demo to 3; the depth rule keeps at least 5 nodes per zone), the script needs the step-1 product WORK/SPECFEM3D/DATA/dsm_model_input, taken from the shipped 1D_DSM deck of the same scenario (a pitfall: steps 4 and 5 have no fallback to dsm_model_base). Every other scenario's step 4 is the same mode on its own model and box, left out below.

tests.exercises: Step 5 of every scenario, the box-to-receiver Green's-function database by reciprocity: dsmti with a vertical single force (source_type 2, Fz, comp_excitation_single_force) at the free surface and receivers on the SEM box's radial nodes (26 lower-mantle and 5 outer-core depths at 8 distances of 12.75 to 19.53 degrees), displacement saved; 1000 s window.
tests.why: Suitable with the same shrunk tables as step 4 (prepare_box_to_recv.py, DSM_BOX_TO_RECEIVER_DISTANCE_BUFFER_DEGREES=0); TELESEISMIC_COMPONENT=Z as shipped runs the Fz force only, so Fr and Ft are not exercised by any demo scenario as configured. Every other scenario's step 5 is the same mode, left out below.

tests.exercises: The paper's 410-km discontinuity triplication case: an explosion at 100 km depth in a 10-zone upper-mantle model (SPECFEM3D/DATA/dsm_model_input, the only model family in the tree with a modified transition zone), recorded on a record section of 89 distances from 11.7 to 16.15 degrees at two depths (0 and 1 km), 2048 s window, 4096 frequencies upstream, 512 ranks.
tests.why: Suitable after assembling the deck the script means to build: run.sh writes the distance and depth tables but its relative paths to dsmti and to dsm_model_input are one directory short (pitfall), so the check carries the tables it wrote plus the model it names, edited by the script's own awk (2048 s, source 100 km, explosion, displacement). Runs at SAB_NFREQ frequencies. This family's other cases are left out below.

tests.why: Not a separate check: the frequency count is the SAB_NFREQ knob of pkikp-ic-rotation-equatorial, so this deck forces the same path at another band.

tests.why: Not a separate check: covered by pkikp-icb-topography-explosion through its SAB_NFREQ knob.

tests.exercises: Step 4 in the 12 other scenario roots that carry it (PKIIKP x2, PKIKP x2, PKP660PKP, ULVZ MomentTensor, PKiKP x2, PcP x2, Slab_PP): the same database mode (prepare_src_to_box.py, explosion or six moment-tensor sources, save_velo=2, stress, fluid quantities) on each scenario's model and SEM box.
